name: everest-plunge-pipely-xero-agent
description: Two jobs for Everest Plunge's Pipely-Xero relationship: (1) reconciliation — checks won Pipely deals have a matching Xero invoice, flags anything that doesn't, read-only; (2) deposit invoicing — creates and emails a 50% booking-deposit Xero invoice when a GoHighLevel workflow fires on a deal reaching the 'send deposit' pipeline stage.
